sourceDiscovery.claim: In the tested survival-world generator, deterministic procedural rules plus sparse resource deltas reconstructed the modified state exactly while the sparse description remained far smaller than a compressed explicit full state.
sourceDiscovery.boundary: This is strong evidence for the tested generator/resource-delta model. It does not yet prove that transient or security-sensitive gameplay systems can be reconstructed from sparse deltas.

developmentHypothesis.statement: For persistent gameplay systems with a deterministic base state and stable object identities, storing and synchronizing only causally meaningful player/world changes can reproduce the authoritative state exactly while storage and network cost grow mainly with changes instead of total world size.
developmentHypothesis.kidStatement: Не надо помнить весь огромный мир. Можно помнить правила и только то, что в нём поменяли.
developmentHypothesis.predictedEffect: Applicable systems reconstruct the same authoritative state from base rules plus ordered sparse deltas and use materially less persistence/network data than matched full snapshots.
developmentHypothesis.baseline: Full explicit authoritative snapshots at the same checkpoints.
developmentHypothesis.failureCondition: Any applicable system reconstructs a different authoritative state, depends on unstable identities/order, loses or duplicates changes, violates security/accounting invariants, or does not achieve its preregistered storage/network benefit.
developmentHypothesis.confirmationRule: Freeze identity, ordering, correctness, compression and failure thresholds per system before hidden confirmation histories.

vnoAudit.meaning: These scores measure distance through the VNO validation process; they are not the percentage truth of a real-world law.

passed: source branch preserves exact reproduction commands
four independent spatial windows and four radii were exercised
exact reconstruction and descriptor-size criteria were preregistered
missing: clean-room CI reproduction artifact pinned to dependencies
multiple generator implementations and materially larger scales

passed: source provenance and fixed criteria are preserved
missing: independent verifier not sharing reconstruction logic

passed: fixed refutation rule and no post-result threshold lowering

vnoAudit.nextPriority: Clean-room reconstruction implementation plus independently generated hidden change histories.

gameplayTransfers.reason: This is the source domain: deterministic world rules are the base state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Мир можно снова построить по тем же правилам, а потом добавить только изменения игроков.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Infinite-world persistence that regenerates untouched chunks and loads sparse authoritative edits only where needed.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact reconstructed chunks with persistence size tied more closely to edits than generated area.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Hidden seeds/histories reconstruct chunk hashes exactly and compare persisted bytes at growing radii.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Change generator version/seed metadata and verify stale deltas cannot silently reconstruct as valid.

gameplayTransfers.reason: RUN_059 directly tested sparse resource depletion deltas.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если камень забрали, надо записать только: этого камня больше нет.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Sparse depletion/regrowth history for generated resources using stable resource identities.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact resource state after reload with far less data than full resource snapshots at low edit density.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay hidden depletion/regrowth histories and compare exact resource identities/values plus byte cost.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Reorder deltas and attach values to wrong IDs, including identity collisions.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Player-created structures are persistent deviations from a deterministic base world.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Не надо сохранять пустое место миллион раз. Достаточно записать, где игрок построил дом.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Persist building additions/removals as ordered stable-ID deltas over generated terrain.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Reload produces identical structures while storage grows with build edits.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Full region snapshots containing generated terrain plus buildings.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Build/damage/rebuild hidden histories then compare authoritative voxel hashes after replay.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Duplicate and reorder adjacent build/remove events and test conflicting IDs.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Persistent player/world road changes can be deltas over generated routes.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если игрок сделал новую дорогу, можно запомнить только новую дорогу.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Sparse persistent road additions, closures and repairs with deterministic base-route regeneration.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact route graph after replay while unchanged roads need no explicit snapshot.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay hidden route-edit histories and compare graph nodes/edges and path answers exactly.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Reorder closure/reopen events and migrate route IDs between generator versions.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Only persistent creature facts such as spawn/death/ownership may fit; live AI thoughts do not automatically fit.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Можно помнить, что монстр появился или исчез. Не надо сохранять каждую его маленькую мысль.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Prototype sparse persistence for stable creature lifecycle facts while recomputing transient behavior.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Persistent creature roster/state restores exactly without snapshotting every transient AI tick.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Full serialized creature state at checkpoints.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay spawn/death/persistent-state changes and compare authoritative persistent fields only.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Inject non-deterministic transient state and verify it is excluded rather than falsely reconstructed.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Individual shots are usually transient actions; RUN_059 does not imply gameplay benefit from persisting every shot as a reconstruction delta.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Выстрел случился и закончился. Не каждую вспышку надо хранить навсегда.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Persist only durable consequences through other applicable systems, not cosmetic/transient shot history by default.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Ensure transient combat events are not accidentally promoted into permanent history unless required by an authoritative rule.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Verify replay cannot create duplicate damage from already-consumed shot events.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Durable destruction is a sparse change to generated or built state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если стену сломали, можно записать только эту поломку.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Ordered idempotent destruction/recovery deltas instead of repeated full-world snapshots.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact post-damage world after reload/replay with bounded history growth for sparse destruction.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay break/repair/regrowth histories under reload and compare voxel/event hashes.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Drop, duplicate and reorder damage/recovery events around reconnect boundaries.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Most movement/physics state is transient and RUN_059 does not establish deterministic replay of full physics simulation.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Не надо помнить каждый шаг игрока, чтобы помнить мир.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Persist durable world changes; continue treating ordinary frame-by-frame movement as runtime state.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Regression-check that reconstructed durable geometry yields the same collision contract.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Look for reconstructed geometry that hashes equal at data level but produces different collision behavior.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Frame-level animation is transient; deterministic-base plus sparse durable deltas has not been shown useful here.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Не надо хранить каждый кадр движения героя.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Animation remains derived from current authoritative state rather than persisted as full frame history.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Verify replayed authoritative state starts a valid animation state without storing animation frames.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Check reconnect/reload for frozen or impossible poses caused by missing necessary durable animation state.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Only if weather has deterministic seed/time rules plus sparse exceptional interventions; this is a transfer hypothesis, not established by RUN_059.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Обычную погоду можно получить по правилам, а необычную перемену записать отдельно.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Prototype deterministic weather timeline with sparse persistent overrides for player/world-caused anomalies.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Same authoritative weather after reload using seed/time plus few overrides instead of full timeline snapshots.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Hidden timelines with interventions reconstruct state exactly at sampled times.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Clock skew, reordered overrides and intentionally non-deterministic weather inputs.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Visual effects are usually derived/transient and should not be mistaken for authoritative persistent state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Пыль можно нарисовать снова. Её не обязательно хранить в памяти мира.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Regenerate transient effects from authoritative events instead of persisting effect snapshots.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: N/A as a scientific transfer claim.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Ensure effects remain truthful after replayed state changes without becoming authoritative data.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Verify reconnect does not replay consumed effects as new gameplay events.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Procedural materials can be the deterministic base while durable user/world edits are sparse overrides.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Обычную стену рисуют правила, а твою царапину можно запомнить отдельно.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Sparse persistent material/paint/scar overrides over generated material rules.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact durable visual edits after reload without snapshotting all generated surface data.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Full serialized material state for affected regions.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay hidden durable overrides and compare canonical material descriptors/render inputs.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Generator/material-version migration and conflicting override identity tests.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Most sound is transient feedback derived from events, not durable world state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Звук можно сыграть, когда событие случилось. Не нужно хранить весь звук мира.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Keep durable event state separate from transient audio playback.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Reconnect/replay must not duplicate already-consumed sounds as new authoritative actions.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Replay old durable events and verify audio deduplication semantics.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Event-sourced durable progression resembles base rules plus deltas, but security/accounting invariants demand independent proof.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Можно помнить покупки и награды, а счёт пересчитать по честным правилам.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Prototype auditable progression ledger where durable transactions reconstruct derived balances/state.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact balances/progression from immutable ordered events with less redundant snapshot state and better auditability.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Full progression snapshots plus current authoritative records.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Replay signed/idempotent hidden transaction histories and compare balances, unlocks and invariants exactly.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Duplicate, reorder, omit and forge transaction events; any accounting divergence refutes promotion.

gameplayTransfers.reason: UI explains state and evidence; it is not proof that sparse reconstruction is correct.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Я могу сказать: «мир помнит только изменения», но слова сами ничего не доказывают.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Explain when the world is regenerated and when a durable change was restored, without exposing scientific jargon.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Validate truthful age-5 wording for idea/experiment/verified state.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Reject UI wording that calls storage savings proof of exact correctness.

gameplayTransfers.reason: Sparse authoritative deltas can reduce synchronization traffic only if ordering/idempotency/convergence are independently verified.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Игрокам можно посылать только то, что изменилось, а не весь мир заново.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Delta-first multiplayer synchronization with stable IDs, sequence/version guards and snapshot fallback for recovery.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Peers converge to identical authoritative state with less traffic for sparse edits.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Reordered/duplicated/dropped event simulations compare final hashes, convergence time and transferred bytes.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Disconnect/reconnect, race conflicting edits and inject out-of-order delivery.

gameplayTransfers.reason: This is the core transfer: persist causal change history over reproducible base state.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Мир хранит маленький дневник изменений вместо огромной фотографии всего мира.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Versioned causal delta ledger with stable identities, checkpoints and deterministic replay verification.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Exact authoritative reload/replay with storage growth dominated by meaningful changes.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Compressed full snapshots at equivalent recovery points.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: One-command hidden-history replay compares final state hash, event provenance, byte size and recovery behavior.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Corrupt/drop/duplicate/reorder entries, change schema/generator version and test checkpoint boundary failures.

gameplayTransfers.reason: RUN_059 directly motivates description/storage scaling; streaming/network savings are a new measurable transfer hypothesis.
gameplayTransfers.kidExplanation: Если меняется мало вещей, игре не надо тащить через интернет весь огромный мир.
gameplayTransfers.feature: Stream generated base locally and transmit/cache sparse authoritative changes, with snapshot fallback when delta history becomes inefficient.
gameplayTransfers.predictedEffect: Lower transferred/stored bytes at sparse edit rates without correctness or frame-time regression.
gameplayTransfers.baseline: Full chunk/world snapshots with matched content.
gameplayTransfers.testPlan: Measure bytes, CPU, memory and reconstruction latency across edit densities and world sizes while requiring exact hashes.
gameplayTransfers.falsificationAttack: Increase edit density until deltas lose their advantage and verify automatic fallback rather than metric gaming.

methodUpgradesFromCycle: VNO now distinguishes durable authoritative state from transient derived presentation instead of forcing every subsystem into event persistence.
Every delta-based transfer must attack ordering, duplication, loss and stable-identity assumptions, not only compression ratio.
Performance savings cannot certify correctness; exact authoritative reconstruction remains a separate hard requirement.
Security-sensitive progression/economy is explicitly blocked from promotion without independent accounting/adversarial verification.
Dense-edit regimes must be tested so the system can fall back to snapshots rather than gaming a sparse-only benchmark.

nextLoop.firstAction: Freeze a clean-room delta-log specification with stable identity/order semantics, then give an independent implementation hidden change histories including reorder/drop/duplicate/corruption attacks.
